bagPolicy.summary: The venue may inspect personal belongings at entry; the official general rules do not state a numeric bag limit.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue lists the Parque Tejo parking area immediately next to MEO Arena.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Taxi stands are at Oriente Station and the main entrance of Vasco da Gama Shopping Centre.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: An accessible bar is near the reduced mobility area. The other bars are step-free, but their counters are 110 cm high.

accessibility.summary: Visitors with disabilities can use the accessible northern garage entrance by FIL; the route has ramps, lifts and wide corridors. Contact the arena to reserve an accessible parking space.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general concert re-entry rule for concerts; consult the event instructions.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general will-call pickup procedure for concerts; consult the event instructions.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Admission may include belongings inspection or a body search, and the arena requires a valid event ticket.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
